description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of 'git reset' commands with different options and scenarios. It sets up git repositories, commits, and runs assertions to verify git's reset functionality and behavior with various options.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, running the supplied commands.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified message and file changes.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail, asserting failure behavior.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares files to verify their contents are identical.
